---
title: "Claustrum Connectivity in Prematurity dHCP outlier analysis"
author: "Jil Wendt"
format: html
editor: visual
---

Outlier check and group comparison of claustrum CP between preterm- and full-term-born neonates (dHCP cohort). ANCOVA per target ROI (CP \~ group + age at scan + sex), FDR correction across the 22 target ROIs; repeated after per-ROI exclusion of outlier observations (IQR criterion). Descriptive statistics per ROI with two-sample t-tests (Welch-corrected if an F-test indicates unequal variances).

- Input: `data/dHCP_CP_cog_ses.csv`
- Outputs:
  - `outputs/tables/dHCP_GroupComparison_CP_FTvsPT_TypeIII_<date>.csv` (results/groupcomp_CP_ANCOVA_dHCP.csv)
  - `outputs/tables/dHCP_GroupComparison_CP_FTvsPT_TypeIII_excl<date>.csv` (results/groupcomp_CP_ANCOVA_dHCP_outliers_excluded.csv)
  - `outputs/tables/dHCP_CP_ROI_summary_<date>.csv` (results/descriptives_CP_dHCP.csv)
  - `outputs/figures/dHCP_outlier_counts_per_ROI_<date>.png`: Supplementary Figure S5

# Setup

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(car)
library(emmeans)

fig_dir <- here::here("outputs", "figures")
tab_dir <- here::here("outputs", "tables")
```

#### Helper Functions

```{r}
save_plot_png <- function(plot, filename, width = 9, height = 7, dpi = 300, bg = "white") {
  outfile <- file.path(
    fig_dir,
    paste0(filename, "_", format(Sys.Date()), ".png")
  )
  ggplot2::ggsave(outfile, plot = plot, width = width, height = height, dpi = dpi, bg = "white")
  message("Plot saved to: ", outfile)
  return(outfile)
}
```

## Load data

```{r}
dat_dHCP <- read_delim(
  here("data", "dHCP_CP_cog_ses.csv"),
  delim = ",",
  trim_ws = TRUE,
  locale = locale(decimal_mark = "."),
  na = c(""," ","NA", "NaN", "n/a", ".", "-9999","999"),
  col_types = cols(
    Subject_ID = col_character(),
    Session_ID = col_character()
  ),
  guess_max = 10000
) |> janitor::clean_names()

# --- recode and name important factors ---
# group as factor
dat_dHCP <- dat_dHCP %>%
  mutate(
    group = factor(case_when(
      group == "term" ~ "FT",
      group == "pre" ~ "PT",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ), levels = c("FT", "PT")),
  )

# sex as factor
dat_dHCP <- dat_dHCP %>%
  mutate(
    sex = factor(sex, levels = c("Female", "Male"))
  )
```

# Outlier analysis dHCP

```{r}
long_cp_dHCP <- dat_dHCP %>%
  dplyr::select(subject_id, group, sex, scan_age, starts_with("l_"), starts_with("r_")) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(starts_with("l_"), starts_with("r_")),
    names_to = "roi_code",
    values_to = "connectivity"
  ) %>%
  rename(subject = subject_id) %>%
  mutate(
    roi = factor(roi_code, levels = names(roi_labels), labels = roi_labels)
  )
```

### Overview of number of outliers per variable and values

Using **IQR criterion** for defining outliers as all observations **above q0.75+1.5\*IQR or below q0.25-1.5\*IQR** (where IQR is the difference between the third and first quartile)

##### for CP (main)

```{r}
stopifnot(all(c("subject","roi_code","roi","connectivity") %in% names(long_cp_dHCP)))

long_cp_outliers_dHCP <- long_cp_dHCP %>%
  dplyr::select(subject, roi_code, roi, value = connectivity)

# --- make per-ROI overview of stats ---
cp_stats <- long_cp_outliers_dHCP %>%
  dplyr::group_by(roi_code, roi) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    q1     = stats::quantile(value, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    q3     = stats::quantile(value, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    iqr    = q3 - q1,
    lower  = q1 - 1.5 * iqr,
    upper  = q3 + 1.5 * iqr,
    mean   = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    median = median(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    n      = dplyr::n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# --- make detailed outliers table ---
outlier_table_dHCP <- long_cp_outliers_dHCP %>%
  dplyr::left_join(cp_stats, by = c("roi_code", "roi")) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(value) & ((value < lower) | (value > upper))) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(roi_code, roi) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(n_outliers = dplyr::n()) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::arrange(roi, subject) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(c(value, mean, median, lower, upper), ~ round(.x, 4)))

# --- make compact summary per ROI as overview ---

roi_totals <- long_cp_dHCP %>%
  group_by(roi) %>%
  summarise(total_n = sum(!is.na(connectivity)), .groups = "drop")

outlier_summary_dHCP <- outlier_table_dHCP %>%
  dplyr::group_by(roi_code, roi) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_outliers = dplyr::n(),
    subjects   = paste(subject, collapse = ", "),
    values     = paste(value, collapse = ", "),
    lower      = dplyr::first(lower),
    upper      = dplyr::first(upper),
    mean       = dplyr::first(mean),
    median     = dplyr::first(median),
    .groups    = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(n_outliers))

outlier_summary_dHCP <- outlier_summary_dHCP %>%
  left_join(roi_totals, by = "roi") %>%
  mutate(
    perc_out = 100 * n_outliers / total_n,
    label_text = paste0(n_outliers, " (", round(perc_out, 1), "%)")
  )
```

#### Figure S5: number of outliers per ROI

```{r}
p_cp_outlier_counts_dHCP <- ggplot(outlier_summary_dHCP, aes(x = reorder(roi, n_outliers), y = n_outliers, fill = n_outliers)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_text(aes(label = label_text), 
            hjust = -0.2, size = 3.5) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "rocket", direction = -1) +

  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +

    y = "Number of outliers (IQR rule)",
    title = "Outlier counts per ROI (CP) for dHCP cohort",
    fill = "N outliers"
  ) +
  expand_limits(y = max(outlier_summary_dHCP$n_outliers) * 1.15)

save_plot_png(p_cp_outlier_counts_dHCP,"dHCP_outlier_counts_per_ROI")
```

### Creating dataset with outliers excluded

```{r}
dat_dHCP_excl <- dat_dHCP

for (i in seq_len(nrow(cp_stats))) {
  roi_var <- cp_stats$roi_code[i]
  lower   <- cp_stats$lower[i]
  upper   <- cp_stats$upper[i]
  
  dat_dHCP_excl[[roi_var]] <- ifelse(
    dat_dHCP_excl[[roi_var]] < lower | dat_dHCP_excl[[roi_var]] > upper,
    NA,   # replace outlier with NA
    dat_dHCP_excl[[roi_var]]
  )
}
```

# Group Comparison

### Specific setup

```{r}
options(contrasts = c("contr.sum", "contr.poly"))
stopifnot(is.factor(dat_dHCP$group), is.factor(dat_dHCP$sex))
```

## ANCOVA helper function

```{r}
cp_vars_dHCP <- grep("^l_|^r_", names(dat_dHCP), value = TRUE)

run_ancova <- function(dv, data){
  fml <- as.formula(paste(dv, "~ group + scan_age + sex"))
  df  <- data[, all.vars(fml)] %>% na.omit()
  if (nrow(df) < 20) return(NULL)

  fit <- lm(fml, data = df)

  a3  <- car::Anova(fit, type = 3)

  a3_df <- as.data.frame(a3)
  a3_df$Term <- rownames(a3_df)

  ss_group <- a3_df$`Sum Sq`[a3_df$Term == "group"]
  df_group <- a3_df$Df[a3_df$Term == "group"]
  Fval     <- a3_df$`F value`[a3_df$Term == "group"]
  pval     <- a3_df$`Pr(>F)`[a3_df$Term == "group"]

  ss_res   <- a3_df$`Sum Sq`[a3_df$Term == "Residuals"]
  df_res   <- a3_df$Df[a3_df$Term == "Residuals"]

  # Partial eta^2
  partial_eta2 <- as.numeric(ss_group / (ss_group + ss_res))

  # Estimated marginal means and contrast (FT - PT)
  emm   <- emmeans::emmeans(fit, ~ group)
  comp  <- emmeans::contrast(emm, method = "pairwise") %>% summary(infer = TRUE)

  emm_tbl <- as.data.frame(emm)
  mean_FT <- emm_tbl$emmean[emm_tbl$group == "FT"]
  mean_PT <- emm_tbl$emmean[emm_tbl$group == "PT"]
  diff_FT_PT <- comp$estimate[1]  # FT - PT

  dir_lab <- if (pval < 0.05) {
    if (diff_FT_PT > 0) "FT > PT" else "PT > FT"
  } else {
    if (diff_FT_PT > 0) "NS (FT > PT)" else "NS (PT > FT)"
  }

  tibble(
    dv            = dv,
    ROI           = dplyr::recode(dv, !!!roi_labels, .default = dv),
    N             = nrow(df),
    F             = as.numeric(Fval),
    df1           = as.numeric(df_group),
    df2           = as.numeric(df_res),
    p             = as.numeric(pval),
    partial_eta2  = partial_eta2,
    emmean_FT     = as.numeric(mean_FT),
    emmean_PT     = as.numeric(mean_PT),
    diff_FT_minus_PT = as.numeric(diff_FT_PT),
    Direction     = dir_lab
  )
}
```

## Run ANCOVA on full cohort

```{r}
res_group_dHCP <- map_dfr(cp_vars_dHCP, run_ancova, data = dat_dHCP)

res_group_dHCP <- res_group_dHCP %>%
  mutate(
    p_FDR = p.adjust(p, method = "fdr"),
    F_string = sprintf(
      "F(1, %d) = %.2f, p = %s%s",
      df2,
      F,
      ifelse(p < .001, "< 0.001",
             sprintf("%.3f", p)),
      ifelse(p_FDR < .001, "***",
             ifelse(p_FDR < .01, "**",
                    ifelse(p_FDR < .05, "*", "")))
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(p, p_FDR)

#Save CSV
outfile <- file.path(tab_dir, paste0("dHCP_GroupComparison_CP_FTvsPT_TypeIII_", format(Sys.Date()), ".csv"))
readr::write_csv2(res_group_dHCP, outfile)
message("Saved: ", outfile)
```

## Run ANCOVA w/o outliers

Single outlier observations removed per ROI (pairwise removal).

```{r}
res_group_dHCP_excl <- map_dfr(cp_vars_dHCP, run_ancova, data = dat_dHCP_excl) %>%
  mutate(F_string = sprintf("F(1, %d) = %.2f, p = %s",
                            df2, F,
                            ifelse(p < .001, "< 0.001**",
                                   ifelse(p < .01, sprintf("%.3f*", p),
                                          sprintf("%.3f", p)))))

res_group_dHCP_excl <- res_group_dHCP_excl %>%
  mutate(p_FDR = p.adjust(p, method = "fdr")) %>%
  arrange(p, p_FDR)

# Save CSV
outfile <- file.path(tab_dir, paste0("dHCP_GroupComparison_CP_FTvsPT_TypeIII_excl", format(Sys.Date()), ".csv"))
readr::write_csv2(res_group_dHCP_excl, outfile)
message("Saved: ", outfile)
```

# CP Descriptives

```{r}
stopifnot(!anyNA(long_cp_dHCP$roi))

classify_type <- function(roi_code) {
  out <- dplyr::case_when(
    grepl("_claustrum_(c|sc)_", roi_code) ~ "Limbic",
    grepl("_claustrum_ac_",     roi_code) ~ "Associative",
    grepl("_claustrum_pc_",     roi_code) ~ "Primary",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )
  stopifnot(!anyNA(out))
  out
}

# row order
roi_region_order <- c("ac_occ","ac_par","ac_pfc","ac_temp",
                      "pc_aud","pc_mot","pc_sens","pc_vis",
                      "c_ant","c_pos","sc_hip")

summarize_roi_t <- function(long_df) {
  rois <- long_df %>%
    dplyr::select(group, roi_code, roi, connectivity) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(group), !is.na(connectivity)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(Type = classify_type(roi_code)) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(roi_code, roi, Type) %>%
    tidyr::nest() %>%
    dplyr::ungroup()
  
  purrr::map_dfr(seq_len(nrow(rois)), function(i) {
    df  <- rois$data[[i]]
    rc  <- rois$roi_code[i]
    rnm <- as.character(rois$roi[i])
    typ <- rois$Type[i]
    
    x <- df %>% dplyr::filter(group == "FT") %>% dplyr::pull(connectivity)
    y <- df %>% dplyr::filter(group == "PT") %>% dplyr::pull(connectivity)
    if (length(x) < 2 || length(y) < 2) return(NULL)
    
    var_p     <- tryCatch(var.test(x, y)$p.value, error = function(e) NA_real_)
    use_welch <- is.finite(var_p) && var_p < 0.05
    
    tt    <- t.test(x, y, var.equal = !use_welch)     # t = FT - PT
    tt_t  <- unname(tt$statistic)
    tt_df <- unname(tt$parameter)
    tt_p  <- unname(tt$p.value)
    
    tibble(
      Type = typ, ROI = rnm, roi_code = rc,
      n_FT = length(x),
      mean_sd_FT = sprintf("%.3f±%.3f", mean(x), sd(x)),
      min_FT = sprintf("%.3f", min(x)), max_FT = sprintf("%.3f", max(x)),
      range_FT = sprintf("%.3f", max(x) - min(x)),
      n_PT = length(y),
      mean_sd_PT = sprintf("%.3f±%.3f", mean(y), sd(y)),
      min_PT = sprintf("%.3f", min(y)), max_PT = sprintf("%.3f", max(y)),
      range_PT = sprintf("%.3f", max(y) - min(y)),
      `t(df)` = sprintf("%.3f(%s)%s", tt_t,
                        ifelse(use_welch, sprintf("%.2f", tt_df), as.integer(round(tt_df))),
                        ifelse(use_welch, "*", "")),
      p = ifelse(tt_p < .001, "<.001", sprintf("%.3f", tt_p)),
      mean_FT_num = mean(x), median_FT_num = median(x), t_num = tt_t
    )
  }) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(region = sub("^[lr]_claustrum_(.*)_[lr]$", "\\1", roi_code),
                  hemi   = substr(roi_code, 1, 1)) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(factor(Type, levels = c("Associative","Primary","Limbic")),
                   factor(region, levels = roi_region_order),
                   dplyr::desc(hemi)) %>%
    dplyr::select(-region, -hemi)
}

cp_table <- summarize_roi_t(long_cp_dHCP)

readr::write_excel_csv2(cp_table, file.path(tab_dir, paste0("dHCP_CP_ROI_summary_", Sys.Date(), ".csv")))
```
